key_insight: A machine learning pipeline using feature selection can help predict PCOS, with AdaBoost performing best after selecting 10 key features.
clinical_relevance: This approach suggests a faster, data-driven screening support tool that could complement traditional PCOS assessment when resources are limited.
method: Compared several feature selection methods, including CatBoost, XGBoost, LGBM, AdaBoost, and Random Forest.
Built ML models on selected feature sets to predict PCOS.
Compared model performance and found AdaBoost with RF Feature Importance + Highest Correlation features performed best.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that AdaBoost using 10 features selected by Random Forest Feature Importance and Highest Correlation achieved the highest test accuracy.
watch_item: Performance is reported from a specific dataset and feature setup, so external validation is needed before real-world use.
paper_title: Investigation of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) Diagnosis Using Machine Learning Approaches
